entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It provides RAG, user profiles, and multi-modal extraction via a single API, with self-hosting available as a single binary.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses a filesystem management paradigm to unify agent memories and skills. It utilizes viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesis and gap analysis for queries. It features a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports local deployment using PGLite.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports MCP and a Python SDK, including bidirectional memory sync.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A context harness that generates persistent playbooks and hints from iterative task runs. It distills successful behaviors into local-model training artifacts and exports CLI-first skills for Hermes integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material and supports optional sensitive pattern redaction.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker/PostgreSQL/Redis setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk. It supports hierarchical scoping and integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and OpenClaw.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable state across multiple agent harnesses and MCP clients. It includes a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first memory and context engine with no cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval via vector search and multi-graph traversal with a shared SQLite vault.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization plugin that reduces prefill latency and token usage through block reordering and deduplication. It is natively compatible with the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It includes contradiction tracking and a built-in outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with a purpose-built evidence packet per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server for coding agent clients.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and Tool Search. It uses local BM25 tool ranking to reduce prompt token overhead.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses an embedded.lbdb graph database for storage. It features importance-weighted recall and supports BM25 keyword search and GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that offers cross-agent recall with semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports durable state storage via session snapshots and TTL.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual memory storage and configurable query expansion.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider featuring 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It uses hybrid search methods and provides automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It includes coding-agent CLI support for Hermes Agent and features for automation and design system management.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to six major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and over 26 AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the generation of editable draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes Mermaid text conversion with self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using a two-pass detection system. It is compatible with Hermes and supports a 111-entry word replacement table.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project facilitates collective skill evolution for shared user teams through automated deduplication and quality improvement. It provides unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features 12 metaskills for guided business and code journeys alongside 50 expert frameworks from bestselling books.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, providing slash commands for management.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This implementation provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI. It utilizes progressive disclosure of skill metadata to reduce token usage and supports both programmatic and filesystem-based definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set provides YouTube transcript, search, channel, and playlist capabilities for Hermes Agent. It extracts captions and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts through dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a constraint reporting feature to identify analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed and SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files from documentation and automatically syncs edits back to the source.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to help agents remember work. It includes a pipeline for capturing high-value decisions and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills provide integration for Oracle networks and smart contract interactions, including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. They follow the agentskills.io specification for interoperability.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides official FLUX image generation skills, including standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It offers API integration patterns for webhooks, polling, and error handling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files that provide provenance via citations or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It features real-time progress tracking, checkpoints, and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It employs a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for Hermes Agent that manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This skill provides a 5-layer intelligent retrieval system for Hermes Agent using semantic embeddings and hard triggers. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model reasoning capability and tracks quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and integration risks. It is a read-only tool that identifies problems without fixing them.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with MCP. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for multi-story task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for managing persistent task state.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill that uses a three-agent swarm to target hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and integrates federated search with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill provides adjudication for agent-to-agent deals, acting as a trust layer for commerce. It includes natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. This repository ensures up-to-date environments through daily automated updates for all included packages.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on Android via Termux. It features an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights or Docker. It features a GUI, integrated workflow engine for multi-step pipelines, and a toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart designed for Kubernetes deployment with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent storage and supports both direct and CRD-based workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Implements hardware-level sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. This approach provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state via mounted home directories and allows for specific tag builds using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible, declarative Hermes deployments. It manages hybrid skill sets and integrates secure secrets via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane that orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It enables hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. This setup is designed for production-ready, autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform enables task dispatching, multi-agent workflow execution, and spend monitoring. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API alongside a memory browser and relationship graph.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and PWA web dashboard for monitoring multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports parallel execution across git worktrees and utilizes Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for agent sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams, this template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates building autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work from a single screen. It includes a Kanban board for task tracking and live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates 9 autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies to compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This tool routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: A local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust via an MCP server and operates with an auto-syncing index.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It provides tracking integrations for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect system prompts, tool calls, and streaming API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding agents. It allows users to debug behavior by comparing adjacent requests and exporting HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: An MCP-based tool that provides design systems and layout guidance to help AI build better UIs. It integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate apps. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous operation on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A collection of community CLI themes for the Hermes terminal UI. It uses YAML-based configuration to customize ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors with aesthetics like cyberpunk and retro DOS.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents featuring identity registration with human-readable @handles. It supports Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively without OAuth or external processes and includes MLOps tools for RL training and vLLM or GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser that enables autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time supervision, session management, and an integrated research desk.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that creates scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations. It allows for project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions while switching between default and scoped agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup utilizing RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings. It provides 40+ pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a Hermes Agent stack and 12+ supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and support for 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that uses seven structural detectors to scan agent configs, system prompts, and tool descriptions without LLM calls. It supports .prompt, JSON, YAML, and plain text formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool that transfers agent personas, memories, skills, and workspace files from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps OpenClaw model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles credential transfers.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability system that monitors multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin for exporting tool call and API request telemetry to track memory bloat and cost estimation.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It is built with Tauri 2 for efficient desktop performance on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies multiple CLI agents, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, into one interface. It features a built-in agent engine with zero configuration and automates document creation for PPT, Word, and Excel.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface providing full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It features a three-panel layout with workspace file browsing and supports secure remote access via SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers through a guided setup.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that supports multi-platform AI chat, session management, and scheduled jobs. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways. It provides a full-page Hermes Web workspace for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime with LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit that supports Codex, Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot CLI. It provides per-session API-equivalent spend reporting using local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud computers and SSH hosts. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It consolidates chat, sessions, and configuration into a terminal dashboard with integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based Telegram Mini App dashboard featuring a mobile-first UI. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, a workflow engine for multi-step automation, and support for local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. It includes an integrated file browser and a dashboard for managing tasks, skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside inspection of conversation histories and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming responses.
